semantic_contract: parse the userspace value with base 10 through kstrtouint_from_user
return -EINVAL on parse failure without logging or taking the mutex
log the parsed firmware operation value before taking the mutex
for values below 11, invoke the optional callback at tpd_cdev + 0xe18 with NULL and zero, free data and firmware, clear tpd_cdev + 0xc58 and reset tpd_cdev + 0x448
for values at least 11, free the previous firmware, allocate a 24-byte firmware object, allocate value + 24 bytes, store the value, and zero the data buffer
return -ENOMEM on either allocation failure and always release the mutex
